label: Directive
blurb: Assign or instruct a unit of work; the receiver picks it up in its loop without blocking.

label: Escalation
blurb: Raise a blocker or decision upward; the caller parks until it is answered.

label: Decision
blurb: Answer an escalation and resume the waiting caller with an authoritative decision.

label: Report
blurb: Notify status or completion upward; fire-and-forget, no reply expected.

label: Request
blurb: File a ticket into a provider's queue for it to shape, route, and fulfil.

label: Consult
blurb: Ask a specialist for a non-binding opinion; advisory, not an order.

label: Review
blurb: Independently judge a submission against acceptance criteria; may gate progression.

label: Handoff
blurb: Transfer ownership of an artifact to a peer or the next stage.
